summary: National Bank Holdings Corp filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, disclosing that on September 30, 2026 its board approved an additional share repurchase authorization of up to $40.1 million of Class A common stock, supplementing $59.9 million remaining under the existing authorization for aggregate authority of $100.0 million. Separately, Item 2.06 disclosed expected material credit impairments on $65.0 million of commercial loans, primarily franchise and healthcare, estimated to be charged down to $18.2 million, producing roughly $46.8 million of charge-offs, $38–40 million of quarterly provision, a $4.0 million FinTech investment impairment, and a $32–34 million after-tax hit ($0.72–$0.76 per diluted share). No expiration date; buybacks may use open-market, negotiated, or 10b5-1 transactions. Watch credit deterioration versus capital return pace and any revised provisioning guidance.
